units: Sabb. IV, 1 (49ᵃ) נ׳ של חרשין וכ׳ (Talm. ed. נְסוֹרוֹת pl.) (fine) saw-dust of the carpenters; Y. ib. 6ᵈ bot. אנן תנינן נ׳ … נעורת וכ׳ we read n’soreth, the teachers of the house of Rabbi read n’ʿoreth, which shows that both mean the same.

<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 10:10">B. Kam. X, 10</cite> (<cite ref="Bava Kamma 119a">119ᵃ</cite>) <he>אף הנ׳ של בעה״ב</he> Y. ed. (Mish. ed. <he>הנִסָּרוֹת</he>, some Bab. ed. <he>הנִסָּרִים</he>; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 200; Ar. <he>הנסורות</he>) even the saw-dust belongs to the employer.
